comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Hi @StefanFabian, can you please update this issue to list the release repositories that this team will be responsible for managing?

We need at least one repository before we create a release team.

comments.author: StefanFabian
comments.body:
Okay, I must admit I'm a bit confused.
According to the [docs](https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/How-To-Guides/Releasing/First-Time-Release.html) I need to be part of a release team before I can create a new release repository.
We do have our own release org from ROS 1 times (see [hector_slam release repository](https://github.com/tu-darmstadt-ros-pkg-gbp/hector_slam-release)) but as I understood it, we should now use this org for release repos.

So, if I understand correctly, I should first make an "Add New Release Repositories" issue contrary to what the docs say?

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Sorry for the confusion. The intended path through that documentation is that you'd start a new release team following https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/How-To-Guides/Releasing/Release-Team-Repository.html#start-a-new-release-team and open this issue. What's missing based on the template is the release repositories that this team will own. It's not required that the release repositories exist already. By way of example, if your plan is to release `hector_slam` for ROS 2, you would list `hector_slam`.

This new release team template adds both the team and repositories, whereas the "Add new release repositories" template is for adding new repositories to an existing team.

comments.author: StefanFabian
comments.body:
Ah okay, thank you for the explanation.
I have added the two repositories I intend to release right now.

comments.body:
